edits.new:
def discounted(amount, percent):
    return amount * (1 - percent / 100)
edits.old:
def discounted(amount, percent):
    return amount * (1 - percent)

patches.rationale: money.discounted currently treats percent as a fraction (amount * (1 - percent)), so 20 means 2000% off. Fix: interpret percent as a percentage, dividing by 100. checkout.invoice_total applies tax to the original amount; fix: apply tax to the discounted subtotal. Preserve no-discount/no-tax behavior: discounted(100,0)=100, invoice_total(100,0,0.1)=110, invoice_total(0,20,0.1)=0. New regression tests cover the stated example (100, 20, 0.1 -> 88) and boundary/preservation cases.
